module_summary: I2C slave to Wishbone master bridge: an i2c_slave core streams bytes to a 6-state FSM that loads an auto-incrementing address register, coalesces bytes into words, and issues Wishbone reads/writes.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Bridge FSM: idle, address load, read and write Wishbone phases

anchors.name: count_reg
anchors.why: Byte counter indexing address bytes and word byte lanes

anchors.name: last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Last byte of I2C transaction, ends write sequence

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy while FSM is not idle

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Auto-incrementing byte address loaded from I2C header bytes

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Word buffer coalescing write bytes or holding read data

anchors.name: wb_adr_o
anchors.why: Wishbone word address from addr_reg upper bits

anchors.name: wb_dat_i
anchors.why: Wishbone read data captured into data_reg

anchors.name: wb_we_o
anchors.why: Wishbone write enable set for write cycles

anchors.name: wb_sel_o
anchors.why: Byte selects marking bytes written in coalesced word

anchors.name: wb_stb_o
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe asserted in read/write wait states

anchors.name: wb_cyc_o
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle line for read/write transfers

anchors.name: wb_ack_i
anchors.why: Wishbone ack completing read/write and advancing address

anchors.name: wb_err_i
anchors.why: Wishbone error treated as cycle completion

anchors.name: i2c_sda_i
anchors.why: I2C serial data input to slave core

anchors.name: i2c_scl_i
anchors.why: I2C clock input to slave core

anchors.name: i2c_sda_o
anchors.why: I2C data output driven by slave core

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Received I2C byte stored into address or data registers

anchors.name: data_out_valid
anchors.why: Received byte valid; starts address phase and write bytes

anchors.name: data_out_ready_reg
anchors.why: Ready to accept received bytes in address/write states

anchors.name: data_out_last
anchors.why: Last received byte; ends transaction or triggers write

anchors.name: data_in_valid_reg
anchors.why: Read byte valid to slave core for transmission

anchors.name: data_in_reg
anchors.why: Byte of read word sent to I2C master

anchors.name: data_in_ready
anchors.why: Slave core requests read data; triggers Wishbone read

anchors.name: bus_addressed
anchors.why: Device addressed flag; exits read state when dropped

anchors.name: bus_active
anchors.why: I2C bus activity status from slave core

anchors.name: device_address
anchors.why: 7-bit I2C slave address configuration

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables I2C slave core

groups.name: Bridge controller
groups.description: FSM sequencing address load, Wishbone reads and coalesced writes

groups.name: Address and data registers
groups.description: Auto-increment address pointer and word coalescing buffer

groups.name: Wishbone master
groups.description: Registered Wishbone master outputs and ack handling

groups.name: I2C slave core
groups.description: I2C slave shifting bytes to/from byte streams
